msg: Hello! We're a Dutch family of five visiting Cartagena: my wife and I are both certified divers (Open Water, 2019), our daughter Sanne is 12, and my mother-in-law, who doesn't swim much, is with us. What could we do together in a day?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

A lovely family day in the Rosario Islands is possible, with different activities combined on the same trip. Your mother-in-law can join as a *boat companion* without going in the water; snorkeling is another option if she feels comfortable, but it does involve being in the water.

You and your daughter could do the *certified 2-dive trip* if she holds an Open Water certification. If she isn’t certified, she can try the *Dive Mini Course* at age 12. The group can combine certified diving, the mini-course, and snorkeling on the same day, though snorkeling takes place in a different area from the dives.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
*From Cartagena* — boat from Muelle de la Bodeguita · lunch included
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD
*Already on the Rosario Islands* — pickup at your hotel if it has boat access · no lunch
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 124 USD · 138 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 134 USD · 149 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 45 USD · 50 USD

*Group discount (5 people or more):* an extra 10%, on top of the 10% online discount (20% total when booking online). It isn't automatic: ask the team before paying, or it's lost. It doesn't apply to PADI courses.

So, would you leave *from Cartagena* (Muelle de la Bodeguita)? 🚤

msg: Yes, from Cartagena. To clarify: my wife and I would do the 2-dive trip, Sanne isn't certified so she'd try the mini course, and my mother-in-law would come as the companion. Does the companion pay anything, and does the group discount apply with five of us?
reply:
Yes, the companion plan is paid: it’s *$80 USD online* or *$89 USD regular*. It includes the round-trip boat from Cartagena, lunch, insurance, and the National Natural Park entrance fee.

With five people, the *10% group discount* applies to the recreational diving, mini-course, and companion plan. It stacks with the 10% online discount, for *20% total when booking online*. The group discount must be requested from the team *before paying*; it isn’t applied automatically. Sanne can do the mini-course at 12, and minors must be accompanied by a responsible adult.

Just to confirm, should I change it?
• 5 people → *4 people*

msg: No, please keep it at 5 people: 2 divers, 1 mini course, 1 companion... that's only 4, sorry, plus Sanne makes it 5 only if she's counted separately? Let me recount: me, my wife, Sanne, my mother-in-law and my son Joost, 9, who'd also like to try. So 5 total. What would Joost do at 9?
reply:
At 9, Joost can try *Bubble Makers*—a children’s introductory experience in a pool or very shallow water, up to 2 m, with a dedicated instructor. He can also choose *snorkeling* (available from age 6). The dive mini-course starts at age 10. For Bubble Makers from Cartagena, the transfer, schedule, and lunch are confirmed by an advisor.

For those who haven't chosen yet I'd recommend these options. Which one do they like best? 🐠
• *Dive mini-course* — A first time underwater with an instructor: pool training and a real dive. No experience needed.
• *Snorkeling* — Enjoy the reef from the surface, with mask and fins. Great for families.
• *Bubble Makers (kids 8-10)*
• *Come along as a companion* — Comes on the boat and enjoys the day with the group, without getting in the water.

msg: Bubble Makers for Joost then. So the plan: two fun dives for us, mini course for Sanne, Bubble Makers for Joost, companion for grandma. Could you give me the total and tell me how to book? An advisor is fine if that's needed for the discount.
reply:
For your five-person group, the 10% group discount applies to the fun dives, mini-course, Bubble Makers, and companion plan. It stacks with the 10% online discount for the activities that can be booked online, but it must be requested before payment. Bubble Makers is booked through an advisor, who can also confirm its transfer, schedule, and lunch. I can’t give a reliable total here because the group discount needs to be applied by the team; the listed per-person prices are below.

Book the two certified divers’ Fun Dives and Sanne’s mini-course separately using their links:
- Fun Dives — 2 dives: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/salidas-de-buceo/1?language=en
- Dive Mini Course: https://book.divingplanet.org/book/minicurso-de-buceo/2?language=en

Bubble Makers and the companion plan are arranged through an advisor in this chat. Please request the group discount before paying.

*Prices per person* (online · regular):
• Bubble Makers (kids 8-10): 168 USD · 187 USD
• Fun Dives - 2 dives (1 day): 178 USD · 197 USD
• 3-dive package (1 day, 2 daytime + 1 night dive): 287 USD · 319 USD
• 4-dive package (2 days, 4 daytime dives): 316 USD · 351 USD
• Dive Mini Course: 183 USD · 204 USD
• Come along as a companion: 80 USD · 89 USD
• Snorkeling Tour: 126 USD · 140 USD

Guests who are not Colombian or residents of Colombia pay in US dollars (USD) by card on the website; the rate is the same, only the currency changes.

Has it been *more than 2 years* since any diver in the group last dived?
